subject.title: Feature: Surface cron job name / session label in /status and statusline

question: Should OpenClaw take the narrow core status-label display fix now, and should maintainers adopt, rebase, or close the linked cross-repo PR candidate?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible on current main, but it has product-decision/no-new-fix-pr signals and an open linked PR candidate, so automation should not start a competing fix until a maintainer chooses the landing path.

options.title: Adopt a narrow core fix
options.body: Land a focused shared-status change that safely propagates friendly labels to CLI/TUI status surfaces and close or supersede the stale linked PR path.

options.title: Wait for contributor rebase
options.body: Ask the linked PR author to rebase against current main, add terminal-safe rendering plus real behavior proof, and keep this issue open until that PR merges or closes.

options.title: Defer to broader attribution work
options.body: Keep the UUID-heavy status behavior for now and treat this as input to the broader status/usage JSON attribution discussion.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow core fix
recommendation.body: Land a focused shared-status change that safely propagates friendly labels to CLI/TUI status surfaces and close or supersede the stale linked PR path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the TUI statusline and shared CLI/TUI status surfaces that this history most strongly ties to `steipete`.
